issues.reason: Coordination & plurals reserves the witness route for episodic clauses and sends a genuinely generic clause (habitual present, characteristic claim) to the rule route, and Striking & relational generics says an adjectivally-restricted kind subject forces the distributing-rule route with the restriction as premise conjuncts — so the existential encoding posits one particular fur, body and sky-cat that this characteristic claim never introduces.

The half that stands is the generic claim's own truth value — an empirical generic rule takes 0.9/0.9, not the individual-fact 0.99 — but 'every atom' overstates it: the compound-decomposition genus (Inheritance sky_cat cat) is definitional and keeps (STV 1.0 0.99) under either routing.

gaps_confirmed: A generic whose surface subject is a bare mass NP but whose intended universal ranges over the OBJECT's possessor ('short feather-like fur covers a sky-cat's body' = for every sky-cat, its body): the rule machinery ranges over the subject kind, and nothing states how to bind an indefinite possessor buried in the object NP as the quantified range.
new_gaps: A MASS kind as the range of a distributing verbal generic: the rule premise form is (Member $x <kind>), which presupposes count instances to quantify over — 'fur' has no natural instance, and no mass-subject range predicate (or portion/quantity witness convention) is defined for the rule route.
defect_summary: Compliant form: one rule at (STV 0.9 0.9) — (Implication (And (Member $x fur) (Member $x short) (Member $x feather_like)) (And (Member (sk_cover $x) cover) (Agent (sk_cover $x) $x) (Theme (sk_cover $x) (sk_body $x)) (Member (sk_body $x) body) (PartOf (sk_body $x) (sk_sky_cat $x)) (Member (sk_sky_cat $x) sky_cat))) with the definitional (Inheritance sky_cat cat) staying outside at 1.0 0.99 — but that quantifies over fur rather than over sky-cats, which is the intended universal and the confirmed gap.
notes: Role assignment is right on its own terms (inanimate transitive subject stays Agent, the unchanged covered body is Theme, the genitive body attaches by PartOf), and feather_like correctly keeps its derived surface form; the defect is the generic-vs-episodic routing.
